def compute_score() -> tuple[str, float]:
    from pptx import Presentation
    prs = Presentation(modified_ppt_path)
    t = prs.slides[0].shapes.title.text if prs.slides[0].shapes.title else ""
    if "Lecture 1" in t and "Lecture 3" not in t:
        return f"Title updated: {t}", 1.0
    return f"Title not updated: {t}", 0.0

def compute_score() -> tuple[str, float]:
    from ppteval.verify.ppt.verifier import ScreenshotsUnavailableError
    o = next((s for s in original_ppt_screenshots if s.slide_number == 1), None)
    m = next((s for s in modified_ppt_screenshots if s.slide_number == 1), None)
    if not o or not m:
        raise ScreenshotsUnavailableError("slide 1 screenshots missing")
    prompt = """Compare these two PowerPoint title slides (original vs modified).
Task: the title should now read 'Lecture 1' instead of 'Lecture 3', with no other visible change to the slide.
Respond with PASS if the modified slide's title shows 'Lecture 1' and the layout/styling otherwise looks unchanged, otherwise FAIL. Add a one-sentence explanation."""
    response = vlm_call(prompt, [o.image_path, m.image_path], temperature=0.3)
    if "PASS" in response.upper():
        return f"Visual check passed: {response}", 1.0
    return f"Visual check failed: {response}", 0.0
